(57) ABSTRACT

A system and computer implemented method are provided.
The method comprises maintaining a database of patent
portfolios and a database of patents, with each patent stored
in the database of patents being associated with one or more
patent portfolios stored in the database of patent portfolios.
The method includes receiving a search query associated
with a first patent portfolio; searching the first portfolio as a
function of the search query; generating a seed set of search
results including one or more patent claims associated with
the search query, the patent claims including terms from the
search query; automatically generating an expanded set of
search resuits including one or more patent claims further
associated with the search query or associated with the
patent claims in the seed set of search results; and mapping
the one or more patent claims to a patent concept.
